use_case_fits.notes: Editorial judgement. A torque-controlled full-size research humanoid with SDK, ROS support and a developer edition recorded from PAL Robotics' TALOS page (https://pal-robotics.com/robot/talos/).
use_case_fits.limitations: About 90 min runtime. Commercial maturity and availability are not verified.

spec_caveats.text: PAL Robotics' TALOS datasheet states '32 DEGREES OF FREEDOM (DoF)': legs 6 (x2), arms 7 (x2), gripper 1 (x2), waist 2, neck 2. The total includes the two gripper DoF.
PAL Robotics states 'Nominal energy 1080 Wh' (lithium-ion battery) on the TALOS datasheet.
PAL Robotics states 'Gazebo simulation and URDF model' (https://pal-robotics.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/TALOS-DataSheet-1.pdf).

PAL Robotics states 'Speed your research with extra software: from Whole-Body Control to navigation, HRI skills or teleoperation.' (https://pal-robotics.com/robot/talos/). Teleoperation is offered as optional PAL software, not necessarily installed by default.
